checks.name: independent audio trace contains a sustained interval longer than 30 s
audio RTP headers include the browser-confirmed Opus SSRC 4006203395 / PT 111
audio RTP payload types are all 111 in the selected conference ports
audio trace contains outgoing and incoming RTP at the verified media server

audio_capture.browser_evidence: Camera disabled; organiser microphone enabled. WebRTC Internals: publisher 77.88.42.81:22556; guest receiver 77.88.42.81:22335, inbound Opus PT111 SSRC4006203395 (0xeec9d003).
audio_capture.capture_limitation: dumpcap log reports 49 en0 packets flushed at capture completion; this is not a measured network loss rate.

text_capture.capture_filter: tcp and host 87.250.250.43 and port 443 and port 58364
text_capture.browser_evidence: Chrome DevTools showed WebSocket HTTP 101; lsof matched 172.19.0.1:58364 -> 87.250.250.43:443. Two local same-account tabs exchanged and independently displayed two control messages.
text_capture.encapsulation: Raw IP on utun4; frame.len has no Ethernet header
text_capture.privacy_postprocessing: editcap -s 160 applied to the saved trace; original frame.len and timestamps retained

checks.name: text trace is nonempty and has a nonzero packet timestamp interval
all text packets belong to the verified bidirectional TCP 58364 / 443 flow
text packets are Raw IP on utun4; IP length equals recorded original frame length
text flow has no UDP/RTP and includes encrypted TLS application records
text snapshots are limited to 160 bytes after privacy postprocessing
saved UI transcript confirms both control messages in two local tabs

limitations: Only the selected encrypted WebSocket notification flow is recorded; this is not all HTTP API or all messaging traffic.
HTTP 101 and the WebSocket URL were observed in DevTools, not read from encrypted pcap payload.
Packet timestamps span the observed traffic; the capture process had a separate 60-second upper limit.
Raw IP text lengths and Ethernet media lengths have different link-layer accounting.
TLS record labels in a midstream trace do not by themselves prove the negotiated TLS version.

phase_comparison.scope: Text: selected TCP/TLS WebSocket notification flow, Raw IP. Audio/video: selected conference media UDP, both local browser participants and directions, mainly Ethernet en0. Video includes audio.
phase_comparison.limitation: Different capture windows, selected services, network conditions, and Raw IP / Ethernet length accounting. Descriptive trace comparison, not full message-service accounting or codec-only bandwidth.

observations: The video trace contains a real mixed audio/video conference; it is not a separate audio-only experiment.
UDP RTP header fields are read with explicit Decode As; SRTP media payload remains encrypted.
Dynamic RTP payload type does not identify a codec without SDP or a corresponding browser observation.
Rates use original frame.len and the actual packet timestamp interval; text snapshots were privacy-truncated to 160 bytes after capture.
The en0 path carries media; utun4 only contains alternate-candidate STUN traffic in this trace.
